يوم تحسيسي وتوعوي لفائدة العاملات: Awareness and information day for female employees
Ooredoo الجزائر تعزّز التزامها بالوقاية: Ooredoo Algeria reinforces its commitment to breast cancer prevention
وفاءً لالتزامها بصحة موظفيها ورفاهيتهم،: True to its commitment to the health and well-being of its employees, Ooredoo Algeria organized an awareness day on breast cancer on Sunday, October 18, 2026, at its headquarters in Ouled Fayet, in partnership with the Mitidja Medical Association for Cancer Diseases.
خُصّصت هذه المبادرة، المنظَّمة في إطار ا: This initiative, organized as part of the global "Pink October" campaign, was dedicated to female employees and aims to raise awareness of the importance of early detection of breast cancer, promote best preventive practices, and encourage a better understanding of the disease.
خلال هذا اليوم، نظمت محاضرة طبية ألقاها: During this day, a medical lecture was given by Professor Boudjella Abdelkader El Hakim, an oncology specialist, who addressed the main aspects related to breast cancer, notably the disease itself, early detection, risk factors, warning signs, and prevention methods.
كما تخلّل هذا اللقاء حيّز للنقاش مع العا: The meeting also included a discussion session with the female employees, giving them the opportunity to obtain reliable information and answers to their questions. In addition to this awareness component, individual medical consultations were conducted by specialized doctors to enable participants to receive preventive medical advice.
من خلال هذه المبادرة التوعوية، تجدّد Oor: Through this awareness initiative, Ooredoo Algeria renews its commitment to preserving the health of its employees, instilling a culture of prevention, and placing awareness, early detection, and medical support at the core of its initiatives.
